result: Muon and its relatives are non-Euclidean steepest descent: pick a norm per layer (spectral for matrices, so the step is −polar(G)), combine them into a product norm, and use either a constrained or a regularized step. This recovers MuonAdam and yields MuonMax; with model-based momentum (Momo) it is much less sensitive to the learning rate.
result_plain: Muon = constrained steepest descent in the spectral norm; product norms give MuonMax, Momo adds robustness.
